job_description:
Business Analyst

Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time
Are you passionate about shaping next-generation SaaS products and intelligent chat experiences? Our client is seeking a Business Analyst, where technology, design, and AI come together to redefine how users interact with digital platforms.
About the Role
As a Business Analyst, you will bridge the gap between product strategy, user experience, and technical execution. You’ll collaborate with UX/UI designers, AI engineers, and stakeholders across multiple teams to design and refine intuitive, data-driven chat interfaces.
Key Responsibilities
Product & AI Chat Experience
•	Partner with UX/UI designers and AI engineers to craft intelligent, user-friendly conversational experiences.
•	Define and optimize chat flows, intents, and user journeys for AI-driven interactions.
•	Monitor and analyze chat performance metrics to continuously enhance engagement and efficiency.
Stakeholder Engagement
•	Act as a liaison between Product Management, Engineering, Data Science, and Customer Success teams.
•	Lead workshops, demos, and feedback sessions to align priorities and validate solutions.
Data-Driven Decision Making
•	Leverage analytics and user feedback to guide product improvements and roadmap planning.
•	Support A/B testing and experimentation for AI chat features.
Documentation & Process Improvement
•	Maintain clear documentation of requirements, workflows, and system interactions.
•	Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to streamline delivery and boost user satisfaction.
Qualifications
•	Proven experience as a Business Analyst within SaaS environments.
•	Experience with AI chat systems, conversational design, or NLP-driven applications is a strong plus.
•	Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
•	Familiarity with agile development methodologies and modern product management tools.
Why Join
•	Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI-enabled SaaS solutions.
•	Collaborative, innovative, and growth-focused team culture.
•	Competitive compensation and flexible work environment.
